headline: Google publishes ARTEMIS, an open-source agent for Android automation and testing
summary: Google’s public ARTEMIS repository provides natural-language Android automation through a reactive Flash profile and a slower plan-and-verify Pro profile, with CLI, Python SDK and MCP integrations for coding environments. The project describes accessibility-tree and OCR targeting with visual fallbacks, execution traces and history summaries. Its README claims 99%+ task completion on AndroidWorld’s 100+ multi-step tasks, but gives no model/version, per-task scores, trial counts or independent evaluation; this remains a first-party claim.
